supported_scope: The reachability-stratification proof gives the full cut-ideal quotient, even cohomology, and the stated invariant recurrence with no extra subset-orbit multiplicity.
The monic Euler-product argument works over the possibly nonreduced complementary quotient.
The formal generating ratio and the substitutions E_Q = D_m, framing pairing = w(m), and half dimension = C(v) + w.v reproduce Hausel v2 Theorem 5 Equation (9) with q = t^2.
RRT v2 Lemma 4.2, Corollary 4.3, and Section 4.4 support the related cocircuit and toric cohomology interpretation, not the Laurent support-length trace theorem.
Empty arrays, unframed components, and unit cuts are included.
remaining_gaps: The determinant-stability to affine central moment-fiber comparison via rotation and Kempf-Ness is a source geometric input, not an old certified result.
The equivariant Thom/Gysin realization of the reachability strata is not independently formalized or certified by the old inventory.
Applying the count to B_0 additionally requires the separate cut-symbol surjection and coefficient/grading-compatible BFN Laurent interface.
Novelty of the particular invariant recurrence and assembly is not established by the related RRT results.
